summary: All three files contain substantial formal mathematical content and should remain in the primary search index. stdpp/base.v is the foundational library file with type classes (Equiv, Decision, Inhabited, ProofIrrel, Inj, Surj, PartialOrder, TotalOrder, etc.), notations, and lemmas for equality, logic, orders, data types (products, sums, options, sigma), set operations, monads, maps, lattices, and set axiomatizations. stdpp/namespaces.v defines the namespace record with nroot/ndot/nclose operations, disjointness instances, and a hint database with lemmas for namespace reasoning. stdpp/telescopes.v defines the tele inductive type for telescopes with tele_arg, tele_fun, tele_fold, tele_app, tele_map, tele_bind operations, telescopic quantifiers (tforall/texist), and equivalence lemmas to standard quantifiers. None are pure import aggregators; all contain original definitions, type classes, notations, lemmas, and proofs.
